Judicial Department No.: RJ/71/2025 IT Cell No.: ITC/689/2025
Modification in the “Methodology for ensuring next
Listing Date in All Pending Cases with effect from Ist
September, 2023”
In continuation of the earlier notification being Judicial Department
No. RJ/17/2023, IT Cell No. ITC/171/2023, Hon’ble the Chief Justice has
been pleased to make the following modifications in the “Methodology for
ensuring next Listing Date in all pending cases with effect from Ist
September, 2023”, w.e.f. 02/07/2025:
(i) The word “But, allocation of a System Generated First Listing
Date of 4th Court working day shall be kept in abeyance for
Wednesday which is a dedicated day as “Targeted Matters
Hearing Day” till further orders.” be inserted in the “Methodology
for ensuring next Listing Date in All Pending Cases with effect from
lst September 2023” attached with the Notification dated
23/08/2023, No. RJ/17/2023 and No.ITC/171/2023 at Para-5 (Page
2 line 7) after the word “Orders of respective Bench”.
By order of Hon’ble the Chief Justice
He
REGISTRAR GENERAL
